reason: This is exactly my problem, I lose my evenings chasing a farmer for his APIA extract and his balance sheet, and 900 plus 50 a month is less than one afternoon of my time per month. But I am being asked to be the second client of a man who does this after his day job, and the only reference does not exist yet; I have been burned by a web guy who vanished, so I will wait until the Bihor consultant answers the phone.
objection: My clients are farmers and small firm owners who send me photos of documents at 22:00 on WhatsApp; I am not convinced they will click a link and upload in order, so I may end up paying 50 a month and still chasing them myself. And if the founder gets a promotion at his real job, I am left with a backup person I have never met.
would_change_my_mind: A 15-minute phone call with the Bihor consultant after his 60 days, telling me his farmers actually used the link and he stopped chasing; then I take the 720 slot the same week.
